function.name: weather_forecast
function.description: Retrieves the weather forecast for a specified location and date, including temperature, precipitation, and wind conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographic location for the forecast, in the format 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'San Francisco, CA' or 'London, UK'.

date.description: The date for which the forecast is being retrieved, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

temperature_unit.description: The unit of measurement for temperature.

include_humidity.description: Whether to include humidity percentage in the forecast.

include_wind.description: Whether to include wind speed and direction in the forecast.

message.content: Shashi Tej Reddy is an Indian politician and former army officer who has been active in the politics of Telangana. He was born in 1965 and served in the Indian Army’s 1/12 Gorkha Rifles, retiring with the rank of Major. After leaving the military, he entered politics and was elected as a Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) from the Jangaon constituency in 2014 as a candidate of the Telangana Rashtra Samithi (TRS). In the TRS‑led state government, he held cabinet portfolios, most notably as Minister for Rural Development and Panchayats, where he focused on water conservation, irrigation projects, and rural infrastructure. His tenure ended in 2019 when he resigned amid controversy over alleged irregularities in land deals.
